description: Bug report from a user of agent-harness: an OpenCode run lost all of its token usage. Its step_finish events carry input and output counts, but one step has no cache field, for example {"type": "step_finish", "part": {"tokens": {"input": 7, "output": 2}}}. For that output, execution._opencode_report returns (None, True, None), so the result records no usage at all. Find the problem and fix it. Change src/agent_harness/ only.
environment: Python >= 3.13 stdlib; base tree = agent-harness 91bb3e1^ (src, docs, tests, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, LICENSE, README, pyproject, .gitignore) plus the task-owned helper bench_fixtures/oc.py; no repository history
visible_checks: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.test_agent_cli (from the workspace root)
provenance: real fix: agent-harness commit 91bb3e1 (fix(execution): keep unknown OpenCode cache units null, 2026-10-11); reference/good.patch is that commit's src/ diff; symptom-only description (one step without a cache field); hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark (2026-10-18): a cache object missing one count, an empty cache object, mixed steps, reasoning, plus guards; the rule is in the base's ADR 0002 (a null unit always means unknown, unknown is never 0); a `cache: null` step is excluded as ambiguous; the fix commit changes no ADR, only a work packet line; other reference patches built by build_task.py. Public repository: contamination possible
